requirements.requirement: The system must define a board_certifications array in the schema containing zero or more certification objects.
The system must define each certification object with fields: certification_name, issuing_body, specialty, and source_raw_text.
The system must include a normalized_specialty field for each certification to enable comparison with queried specialty.
The system must define a relevance_score field as a numeric value between 0 and 1 representing alignment with the queried specialty.
The system must define a confidence field as a numeric value between 0 and 1 representing confidence in extracted certification data.
The system must define an overall_board_certification_score field aggregating relevance scores across certifications.
The system must define scoring contract inputs including queried_specialty and provider credential data derived from NPI registry.
The system must define scoring contract outputs including overall_board_certification_score, relevance_score per certification, and confidence.
The system must ensure the schema is compatible with the existing provider detail response structure without breaking existing fields.
The system must allow the board certification measure to be optional in the response when no credential data is available.
The system must return an empty board_certifications array and a score of 0 when no certifications are present in the input data.
The system must handle malformed or incomplete credential data by setting confidence to a value less than 0.5 and not failing the response.
The system must ensure all numeric scoring fields are consistently typed as floats and not strings in the schema.
The system must ensure the schema supports multiple certifications with independent relevance scores per certification.
